attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long spine.** Columns 0 to 54 carry one family in 92 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 25% of calls. The model names 54 to 100% of genes there, 96% on average, and hesitates most at column 10, `ppiC`, 0.77 bits.

**The first fork and variable stretch follows.** Columns 55 to 62 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 46 to 69% of calls. The model names 79 to 89% of genes, fewest at column 57, 79%, and hesitates most at column 56, `bglF`, 0.71 bits. The branches carry `bglG` to `bglH`, [[carbohydrate transport and hydrolysis]], and at column 61 `cbrB` with `cbrC`.

**Then a second spine.** Columns 63 to 73 carry one family in 93 to 97% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 29% of calls. The model names 93 to 97% of genes, fewest at column 63, `yieH`, 93%, and hesitates most at column 71, `mnmE`, 0.35 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 74 to 79 are in a region of plasticity in 3 to 9% of calls, and the model names 94 to 98% of genes. The branches carry `rnpA` to `dnaN`, then at column 79 `recF` in 42% of chromosomes, with `gyrB` and `yidB`. Across the window the model names 95% of genes, 0.21 bits on average; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.89 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 79% against 97%.

label: wecC
facts:
WINDOW: the wecC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor wecC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,336 to 4,415 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying wecC once); 42,612 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.21 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,845 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; shell 4,598 calls, named 75%, 0.84 bits; cloud 169 calls, named 17%, 3.50 bits. Outside an RGP 38,648 calls, named 97%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 3,964 calls, named 79%, 0.89 bits. Columns: 66 spine, 4 fork, 10 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.89 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (79% against 97%); 3,964 of the 42,612 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 10 (ppiC) 0.77 bits, RGP 0%; column 56 (bglF) 0.71 bits, RGP 64%; column 61 (cbrB) 0.64 bits, RGP 64%. The 6 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 83%, 0.63 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 96%, 0.18 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 55-62 (fork and variable columns), RGP 46-69%; the least: columns 0-54 (spine), RGP 0-25%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-54 (55 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0-25%. Genes: wecC "UDP-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine dehydrog…", wecB, wzzE, wecA, rho, rhoL, trxA, rhlB, gppA, rep, ppiC, ilvC, ilvY, ilvA, ilvD, ilvE, ilvM, ilvG "acetolactate synthase 2 catalytic s…", ilvX, ilvL, yifB "YifB family Mg chelatase-like AAA A…", maoP, hdfR, yieP "FadR/GntR family transcriptional re…", mdtD, rbsR, rbsK, rbsB, rbsC "ribose ABC transporter permease", rbsA, rbsD, kup, ravA, viaA, asnA "aspartate--ammonia ligase", asnC, mioC, mnmG, rsmG, atpI, atpB, atpE, atpF, atpH "F0F1 ATP synthase subunit delta", atpA, atpG, atpD, atpC, glmU "bifunctional UDP-N-acetylglucosamin…", glmS, pstS, pstC, pstA "phosphate ABC transporter permease…", pstB, phoU. named 54-100% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 52 (pstA), named 54%; most hesitant at column 10 (ppiC), 0.77 bits.
2. columns 55-62 (8 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 46-69%. named 79-89% (mean 84%), fewest named at column 57, named 79%; most hesitant at column 56, 0.71 bits.
   55 fork: bglG S 67%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 16%
   56 variable: bglF S 66%
   57 variable: bglB S 66%
   58 variable: bglH S 62% "carbohydrate porin"
   59 variable: yieL S 64% "alpha/beta hydrolase-fold protein"
   60 fork: yieK S 70% "glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase"; also "hypothetical protein" S 10%
   61 fork: cbrB S 72%; also cbrC S 46%, "pentapeptide repeat-containing protein" S 19%
   62 variable: espY4 S 17%
3. columns 63-73 (11 columns) spine: share 93-97%, all P, RGP 3-29%. Genes: yieH "6-phosphogluconate phosphatase", adeP, yieF "class I chromate reductase YieF", yieE "4'-phosphopantetheinyl transferase…", yidZ "HTH-type transcriptional regulator…", mdtL, tnaA, tnaC "tryptophanase leader peptide", mnmE, yidC "membrane protein insertase YidC", yidD "membrane protein insertion efficien…". named 93-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 63 (yieH), named 93%; most hesitant at column 71 (mnmE), 0.35 bits.
4. columns 74-79 (6 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 3-9%. named 94-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 79, named 94%; most hesitant at column 76, 0.32 bits.
   columns 74-78 variable, share 61-89%, all P: rnpA 89%, rpmH 87%, "protein YsdD" 83%, dnaA "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…" 79%, dnaN 61%
   79 fork: recF P 42%; also gyrB P 22%, yidB P 13%

END: the window ends at column 79, recF, in 42% of chromosomes.
